verdict.rationale: Amplitude, an analytics SaaS rather than an agent, documents an official MCP server at amplitude.com/mcp-server, and a probe confirms the page exists. The page says it brings Amplitude's behavioral context into AI tools such as Claude, Cursor, OpenAI, Lovable and Figma for conversational answers. Missing for 10: setup/connection details (endpoint, auth, supported transports), a documented tool/capability list, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
